title: God's Covenant with Abram
description: The Lord promises Abram a son from his own body and descendants as numerous as the stars. Abram believes the Lord, and it is counted to him as righteousness. God makes a covenant with him through a sacrificial ritual, promising his descendants the land from the river of Egypt to the Euphrates.
